title: Default Tags - Auto-Tagging Tests
description: Use Default Tags to automatically tag all tests in the suite.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, we need to categorize our tests. Tags help us run specific test groups - like 'critical' tests or 'smoke' tests. Default Tags auto-tag ALL tests in this suite."
story.context: Default Tags automatically apply tags to every test case in the suite. No need to manually tag each test - it's done once in Settings.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Excellent! All tests now carry the 'diagnostic' and 'critical' tags. We can run just critical tests with --include critical!"

instructions: Add Default Tags with TWO tags: 'diagnostic' and 'critical'
Create test case 'System Status' that logs: 'Checking system status'
Create test case 'Power Status' that logs: 'Checking power status'
Note: Both tests will automatically have 'diagnostic' and 'critical' tags
hints: Default Tags syntax: 'Default Tags    tag1    tag2'
Tags are separated by 4 spaces (or 2+ tabs)
All tests in the suite inherit these tags automatically
You can add multiple tags on one line
solution:
*** Settings ***
Documentation    Critical diagnostic suite
Default Tags     diagnostic    critical

*** Test Cases ***
System Status
    Log    Checking system status

Power Status
    Log    Checking power status

theory.title: Exercise 2.1.4: Default Tags
theory.content:
🏷️ Auto-Tagging Test Cases

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, imagine you have 50 tests. Some are critical, some are smoke tests, some are regression. How do you categorize them?"

"Tags are labels for tests. Default Tags automatically apply tags to ALL tests in a suite. One line in Settings = all tests tagged!"

🔖 What are Default Tags?

Default Tags - Automatically apply tags to ALL test cases in the suite

  • ✅ Suite-level tagging: Tag all tests at once
  • ✅ No duplication: Set once, applies everywhere
  • ✅ Selective execution: Run only tagged tests
  • ✅ Test organization: Group tests by category

Common Tag Categories:

  • 🔹 Priority: critical, high, medium, low
  • 🔹 Type: smoke, regression, integration
  • 🔹 Component: login, api, ui, database
  • 🔹 Speed: fast, slow

📝 Default Tags Example

*** Settings ***
Default Tags    smoke    critical

*** Test Cases ***
Login Test
    Log    Testing login
    # This test has tags: smoke, critical

Logout Test
    Log    Testing logout
    # This test has tags: smoke, critical

Running Tagged Tests:

# Run only critical tests
robot --include critical tests.robot

# Run only smoke tests
robot --include smoke tests.robot

# Exclude slow tests
robot --exclude slow tests.robot

📋 Default Tags Rules

  • 🔹 Syntax: Default Tags tag1 tag2 tag3
  • 🔹 Applies to: ALL test cases in the suite
  • 🔹 Spacing: Tags separated by 4 spaces (or 2+ tabs)
  • 🔹 Case-insensitive: 'Critical' and 'critical' are the same
  • 🔹 Override: Individual tests can add more tags with [Tags]

🎯 Your Task

Create a suite with Default Tags 'diagnostic' and 'critical'. Add two test cases - they'll both automatically inherit these tags without you specifying them per test.
